summary: The SiteRequirements module manages requirements related to site operations, specifically handling various prerequisite options and associated disciplines. It involves managing requirement types, sections, disciplines, and uploading relevant documentation.
purpose: To provide a system for managing site-related requirements, allowing for the categorization and management of disciplines and associated prerequisites, ensuring site compliance and operational standards are met.

workflows.name: Manage Site Requirements
steps: Determine if all disciplines are allowed
Upload associated documents or provide URLs

business_rules: Handle specific document and URL types for requirements
validations: Ensure user session is active during operations
conditions: If user session is null, cancel operations
system_behavior: Display modal popups for detailed requirements
Manage list of included and not included disciplines dynamically
Hide or display sections based on user permissions and session
exceptions: Session-related errors when user session is inactive
Data saving issues when inputs are invalid
